_NOTE: Lines for fares, Pedring's shop and the 'Susan's list' side quest (docs/ECONOMY_PLAN.md). All lines reviewed and approved by the user one at a time on 2026-11-18; new lines start as "draft": true until reviewed. Tokens: {number} = the Akeanon number word for a price 1-10 (word bank w090...w178), {price} = the amount in digits, {item} = the item's Akeanon word, {item_en} = its English name. Money word: piso (prices follow Economy.price_phrase).

shop_greet.speaker: Nong Pedring
shop_greet.note: Pedring's confirmed Ch2 line (Grammar Notes: What vs which). User 2026-11-22: vendors aren't family, so gha, not apo (apo sounded like a grandparent talking). gha is not in the word bank, so it stays unmarked (as in idle_ambient.json).

shop_order.speaker: Player
shop_order.note: Approved 2026-11-18. Pattern confirmed in Ch2 (Pangabay it daya, Nong, ho); here with a market item in place of daya.

shop_price.speaker: Nong Pedring
shop_price.note: Approved 2026-11-18. The price on its own, by the piso rule (see fare_price): Waeong piso.

shop_sure.speaker: Nong Pedring
shop_sure.note: User's line, 2026-11-20. Any vendor asks it when the player picks something that isn't on their errand list (market_panel.gd). Speaker is replaced by the stall's vendor. Sigurado is not in the word bank, so it stays unmarked.

stall_invite.speaker: Nong Pedring
stall_invite.text: Busy day, gha. Can you help me at the stall?
stall_invite.note: Stall helper (docs/MINIGAMES_PLAN.md). All stall_* lines approved in the live review 2026-11-22; gha is not in the word bank, so it stays unmarked.

stall_lesson_1.speaker: Nong Pedring
stall_lesson_1.text: Some will ask "\Tig \pila?" That means how much each. Tell them the price on the board.

stall_lesson_2.speaker: Nong Pedring
stall_lesson_2.text: Then you ask "\Pilang \bato?", how many pieces, and give them that many.

stall_done_today.speaker: Nong Pedring
stall_done_today.text: That's enough for today, gha. Come back tomorrow.
stall_done_today.note: Once a day. English, no new Akeanon.

plaza_ask.speaker: Visitor
plaza_ask.note: Plaza directions game (docs/MINIGAMES_PLAN.md), reviewed live 2026-11-22. {place} = the place's "plaza" name in data/map_data/places.json, whose word_ids are appended.

retake_price.speaker: Rose
retake_price.note: v1.1.6: a second lesson retake the same day (lessons.gd). Same price phrase as fare_price.

fare_price.speaker: Driver
fare_price.note: Approved 2026-11-18. {number} becomes the price phrase (Economy.price_phrase): 1 is just Piso; otherwise number word + -ng piso after a vowel (Limang piso), + nga piso after a consonant (Siyam nga piso); above 10, digits + pisos (15 pisos).

plaza_litter_offer_1.note: Akeanon draft 2026-11-25 (qs012), from the grammar notes + word bank + Zorc Vol. 2; needs the user's line review. basura = garbage (Zorc, from Spanish; not in the bank, so unmarked; sagbot is the native word for trash). park kept in English like the other place loanwords. Lost the English line's martyrs remark; add one back if wanted.

plaza_litter_offer_2.speaker: Lola Ising
plaza_litter_offer_2.text: \Gusto mo \magbulig, \apo? Limang \bato \eang. \Tan-awa sa mga bangko \ag sa mga \tanum.

plaza_litter_offer_2.note: Akeanon draft 2026-11-25 (qs012), from the grammar notes + word bank + Zorc Vol. 2; needs the user's line review. Gusto mo + verb as in Ch3's Gusto mo samitan mag-ubra. Limang bato by the counting rule (Limang piso). bangko = bench (Zorc, from Spanish; not in the bank). No word found for lawn/grass, so it says plants only.

plaza_litter_offer_yes.speaker: Player
plaza_litter_offer_yes.note: Akeanon draft 2026-11-25 (qs012), from the grammar notes + word bank + Zorc Vol. 2; needs the user's line review. mabulig = ma- (will) + bulig, like masimba = will go to mass; unmarked because the bank only has magbulig.

plaza_litter_offer_no.speaker: Player
plaza_litter_offer_no.note: Akeanon draft 2026-11-25 (qs012), from the grammar notes + word bank + Zorc Vol. 2; needs the user's line review. Lit. not yet now. indi = won't, pa = yet (as in eab-as pa).

plaza_litter_offer_later.speaker: Lola Ising
